claims: Max Strus was born March 28, 1996.
Max Strus is 29 years old.
Max Strus is a shooting guard/small forward for the Cleveland Cavaliers.
Max Strus's current team is the Cleveland Cavaliers.
Max Strus wears #2 for the Cleveland Cavaliers.
Max Strus played for the Chicago Bulls in 2019-20.
Max Strus played for the Miami Heat from 2020-23.
Max Strus has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers since 2023.
Max Strus was a 2023 NBA Finalist with the Heat.
Max Strus signed a 4-year, $62.3M contract with the Cavaliers in 2023.
Max Strus made a 59-foot buzzer-beater vs. the Mavericks.
Max Strus attended Lewis University (DII).
Max Strus attended DePaul University (DI).
Max Strus was undrafted in 2019.
Max Strus underwent surgery for a Jones fracture in his left foot.
Max Strus missed the first 67 games of the 2025-26 season.
Max Strus returned on March 15, 2026.
Max Strus scored 24 points (6-of-7 3PT) in 22 minutes against the Dallas Mavericks on March 15, 2026.
Since his return, Max Strus has averaged 8.8 points.
Since his return, Max Strus has shot 40.9% from 3PT.
